prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Asset type: compact PWA editorial hero. A top-down still life on warm recycled paper: one unbranded translucent compact cassette with a completely blank cream label, a short loose ribbon forming a calm loop, two small torn blank memo scraps tucked beneath it, and one dark grease pencil. Cassette-era independent zine photography, tactile xerox halftone grain, imperfect ink registration, screenprinted burnt orange, deep teal, mustard and charcoal palette.
